subject: Security posture & vendor questionnaire — NoviHealth (SOC 2 / VPC / air-gap options)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@novihealth.com>, Kara Liao <kara.liao@novihealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Sep 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security posture & vendor questionnaire — NoviHealth (SOC 2 / VPC / air-gap options)

Hi Ethan & Kara,

Thanks again for taking time this morning — helpful conversation and a good shared sense of priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture: 

Summary of the call
- NoviHealth is evaluating a private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for models that will process PHI and customer PII.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 evidence, HIPAA handling/path for BAAs, network isolation, and whether an air-gapped pattern is viable for your ops.
- Novi would like a vendor security questionnaire completed and a short workshop to walk through deployment diagrams.

Actions we committed to (Redwood)
1) Attach: Redwood vendor questionnaire (initial draft) — see attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_NoviHealth_v1.xlsx. Please fill sections 1–3 and mark any items you want us to prioritize for the workshop.
2) Ask: Could you share an internal network diagram (high level) showing the VPC/DMZ boundaries and any on-prem connectivity? We included a placeholder we can annotate (requested-network-diagram-placeholder.pdf).
3) Provide: Short doc summarizing deployment options (VPC private subnets, dedicated hardware, and an air-gap plan) — attached redwood-deployment-options-summary.pdf.
4) Timeline: if we get the questionnaire back by EOD Tue (9/12) we can schedule a 60-minute technical workshop for Wed (9/13) or Thu (9/14) to walk diagrams and identify evidence gaps.

Questions for you
- Is SOC 2 Type II required before pilot, or is SOC 2-in-progress acceptable for an NDA-backed pilot?
- Do you have a preferred KMS provider for customer-managed keys (e.g., AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault)?
- Any regulatory reviewers we should include (privacy, HIPAA/security) for the workshop?

Attachments
- Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_NoviHealth_v1.xlsx (attached) — lightweight, many questions are yes/no with short fields for evidence links.
- redwood-deployment-options-summary.pdf (attached) — one-pager comparing VPC/dedicated/air-gap.
- requested-network-diagram-placeholder.pdf (attached) — we can annotate this in-session.

Next meeting: Proposed 60-min workshop (technical + compliance) — Wed 9/13 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 9/14 2:00–3:00 PT. Which works?

Thanks — I’ll also loop in Marcus and Soojin (security engineering) to lead the technical portion.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---

(Attachment stubs: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_NoviHealth_v1.xlsx [application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet], redwood-deployment-options-summary.pdf [application/pdf], requested-network-diagram-placeholder.pdf [application/pdf])

From: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@novihealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Liao <kara.liao@novihealth.com>, procurement@novihealth.com
Date: Fri, 07 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security posture & vendor questionnaire — NoviHealth (SOC 2 / VPC / air-gap options)

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) SOC 2 status: NoviHealth is currently in the middle of a SOC 2 Type II audit (fieldwork ongoing, report targeted Q4). For pilots we usually accept vendors that are SOC 2-in-progress, provided we can review interim evidence and have clear compensating controls.
2) HIPAA & BAA: we will need a BAA in place for any PHI work. Our privacy counsel will want to review your data flows during the workshop.
3) KMS: we prefer AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs for production; pilot can use Redwood-managed keys if documented.

We can get the questionnaire back with sections 1–3 completed by Tue EOD (9/12). I attached a minimal network sketch from our infra team (attached as Novi_internal-network-sketch.pdf) — it's high level but should help for the workshop.

Workshop timing: Wed 9/13 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. Kara and I will invite our security reviewer and a member of privacy.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Ethan Zhao
Director of Infrastructure & Security
NoviHealth
ezhao@novihealth.com

---

(Attachment stub: Novi_internal-network-sketch.pdf [application/pdf])

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Sep 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security posture & vendor questionnaire — NoviHealth (SOC 2 / VPC / air-gap options)

Laura / Soojin — quick internal note before the workshop: 

- If Novi is SOC 2-in-progress that should be acceptable for a pilot, provided we surface interim evidence (control mappings, SOC 2 scope doc). Please request a link to their control matrix during the workshop.
- For PHI: confirm that they want Redwood to act as a HIPAA business associate; if yes, route this to legal early.
- Technical prep: I recommend we prepare two short diagrams for the workshop (1) VPC private-subnet deployment with customer VPC peering and CMK flow, (2) on-prem air-gapped ingestion flow with an offline model sync process. Keep both to one slide each.
- Timeline: we should be able to deliver the two annotated diagrams + an evidence checklist by Tue EOD if we get their questionnaire and the Novi network sketch today.

I'll draft the slide images and upload to the shared Drive folder (link to be included in the invite). Also assembling a short list of SOC 2 artifacts we can request.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security posture & vendor questionnaire — NoviHealth (SOC 2 / VPC / air-gap options)

Ethan / Kara / Procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the network sketch. We received the Novi internal sketch and Marcus is pulling together the two deployment diagrams for the workshop.

Attached: updated vendor questionnaire (we pre-filled the 'Redwood-provided evidence' columns where possible) — Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_NoviHealth_v1.xlsx (updated).

For the workshop on Wed 9/13 10:00–11:00 PT we will:
- Review your completed questionnaire sections 1–3 and agree on missing evidence.
- Walk the Novi network sketch and overlay the two proposed deployment diagrams (VPC peering + air-gap).
- Identify immediate blockers for a pilot (BAA, interim SOC evidence, key management).

Ask ahead of the meeting: please (1) confirm whether procurement needs a PO/contract draft in advance, and (2) share any internal reviewers we should include on the invite (privacy counsel, infra lead).

Invite & shared materials will come from my calendar in a few minutes (Drive folder + meeting link included).

Thanks — speak Wed.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
